facts.fact: Each app has own Go module for real claude tests (apps/kira-space/tests/claude/ and apps/kira-studio/tests/claude/); opt-in works by absence: go test ./..., lint:go, CI and hooks stop at nested go.mod, no build tag or env flag.

facts.fact: Never add root go.work: workspace mode pulls nested test modules into ./...

facts.fact: Run real claude tests with bun run test:claude (both apps), test:claude:space or test:claude:studio; extra go test flags such as -run can be appended.

facts.fact: bun run lint:claude compile-checks claude test modules without spending, using golangci-lint in both modules.

facts.fact: After changing code in an area of real claude test table, run matching row before calling change done, with -count=1 because go test caches passing run and prints old spend.

facts.fact: Resume test rows use held hold.sh Bash call, app restart and Resume; prompts say call is safe to rerun and to inspect nothing first, otherwise haiku runs ps/ls, gets denied (no approval surface), stops as blocked.
